cards.text: VEL-STREET-CONCOURS-01 — WHAT ARE YOU WEARING TODAY (WEEKENDER · MERIDIAN · VIVIENNE)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: v3 (2026-09-03) RESTORYBOARD after Brooks's review. Whole body in every shot, camera tilts down to the bag during the review and back up. Bags at true dimensions anchored to her body. Every named prop on screen and correct (cuff + Rolex upright, David Yurman cable rings + a distinct heirloom ring, Cartier tank upright, plain tote interior with no label, Vivienne straps hanging beside the side edges). Script fixes: 'no label', 'the rings are David Yurman', 'the trousers are Vince'. Pronunciation reference and QA now cover every proper noun. KEYFRAMES ON THE BOARD FOR APPROVAL; Seedance fires after.

cards.title: OUR VERSION v3: full body every shot, true bag sizes, props match the words  ·  Velantra, 3 x 30s + 3s end card = 93s, runs to the collection page

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: v3 RULINGS (Brooks 9/03)
cards.text: Whole body in all shots, tilt down to the bag for the review. True dims: Weekender 18x14.5x7 in, Meridian 14.6x9.4x5.9 in (37x24x15 cm), Vivienne 38x27x20 cm. Props must match the words (cuff shown, DY cable rings, heirloom ring distinct, watches upright). No invented interior label. Fix 'Beard', 'Leone', 'Aquazzura' pronunciation. 'No label' not 'no brand'. 'Trousers are Vince'.

cards.title: v2 RULING (Brooks 9/02)
cards.text: Every spoken line is a complete, naturally flowing sentence with its object: 'It holds three days' worth of clothes and it still fits in the overhead bin', never 'Holds three days, slides in the overhead bin'. Calibrated on the @shoppingwith.vale yapper. Runs to the collection page; offer announced once at the end, not per person.

cards.title: APPROVE HERE
cards.text: Nine keyframes, three per woman: K1 start (the Seedance 2.5 first frame), K2 lift, K3 jewelry. Approve or reject per card. Rejects get a re-roll with the sibling variants already on disk (three per frame). Nothing animates until this board is approved.

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Mirror the reference beat for beat: mid shot, lift the bag to the lens, hold it still, tilt down the outfit, rings or watch on the bag handle, face, out. Overcast lawn, vintage cars, hats, crowd behind. Handheld phone, crooked framing, no music, no mic in shot. Product in frame in every beat. 'No brand' answer stays in.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No spoken interviewer (cards only). No handbag brand named other than Velantra. No 'Birkin' in any generation prompt. No shoulder carry on the Weekender or Vivienne. Never open, unfasten or press the Weekender on camera. No 'structured' for the Vivienne. No em dashes, no 'our', no 'we'. Never name the real event.

cards.title: ENGINE NEXT
cards.text: Seedance 2.5 (kie bytedance/seedance-2-5 or Higgsfield), first_frame = the approved K1, duration 26 matching the FORMAT line and beat windows, generate_audio true, creator voice cloned in ElevenLabs as the audio reference so 'Velantra' is pronounced right. Weekender lift beat is the hardware-mutation risk: fallback is K2 hard-cut into the take. Cards, captions and segment cuts in post.

cards.title: FLAGS
cards.text: Meridian: all six colorways were oversold ~1,760 units on 8/21; no spend on W2 until stock or a pre-order PDP with a ship date. Vivienne is pre-order, ships October, stated in beat 6. Prices verified live 9/02: Weekender $159.99 (cmp $209.99), Meridian $124.99 (cmp $149.99), Vivienne $149.99 (cmp $199.99).
